title: The A-Wing Fighter
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: The A-Wing Fighter from RETURN OF THE JEDI was one of the last  vehicles from the trilogy to be produced by Kenner Products. This illustration (front, collection of Thomas H. Neiheisel) from the Libby Perszyk Kathman studio is a near ringer for the craft designed by ILM's Joe Johnston. Originally scheduled to be issued in a "Power of the force" box, it was instead packaged under a "Droids" logo.
